content.description:
Bidali is a new digital commerce experience that helps you keep more of your money. Businesses that use Bidali can increase sales, save on fees, get paid faster, and eliminate fraud. We've completely overhauled the payment experience by making it simple, free, and rewarding. Get paid to shop. Shop at brands you already know and love and get instant cash back. Send and receive money for free. Buy gift cards for others or instantly send them Bidali Cash 2 and let them choose. Get exclusive offers. Stack your rewards by combining cash back with exclusive offers from amazing brands. How does it work Download the Bidali app, create your account, and top up your balance in just a few taps. We encrypt your data right on your device so only you can access your funds and you are in complete control. Top up your Bidali Account balance and buy gift cards from thousands of local and international brands. After a successful purchase you'll instantly earn Bidali Cash † back. Use your digital gift cards to pay online or in store, or send them to a friend. You can always top up with additional gift cards or other payment methods. Such a great way to budget and save! Stretch your money further and use your earned Bidali Cash to buy more gift cards, send to a friend, or pay in store and online where Bidali is accepted. All for free . No catches or hidden fees. Stack your savings by getting access to exclusive offers from local and international brands. Businesses are able to immediately send you credit that you can redeem alongside your gift cards and Bidali Cash. Win, win, win!
